title: Computer Science - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)
institution: University of Waterloo, David R. Cheriton School of Computer Science
about: The University of Waterloo's Cheriton School of Computer Science accepts PhD applications for September 2027. The program page sets a 1 December deadline for September admission; reference letters are due within 14 days of the deadline.
requirements: Application documents due on the deadline day; reference letters within 14 calendar days of the deadline
Waterloo advises applying at least two weeks before the deadline

upskill.name: EduCut AI Academy catalog
why: No single course genuinely matches: the record lists only application logistics ("Deadline December 1 for September admission", "reference letters within 14 calendar days of the deadline") and no skills; shortlist scores came from generic stems ("comput", "document", "deadline"), not from role requirements.
Catalog fallback lets prospective computer science PhD applicants choose the Academy relevant to their own research interests.
